candidate_relations.reason: “None” does not identify the benchmark diagnosis of leiomyosarcoma.
Gastrointestinal stromal tumor is a separate diagnostic entity from leiomyosarcoma, despite both being mesenchymal neoplasms.
GIST is not equivalent to the benchmark diagnosis of leiomyosarcoma.
Leiomyosarcoma is a type of sarcoma, but “sarcoma” omits the required smooth-muscle subtype.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broad parent category lacking histologic subtype

case_quality_flags: Clinical record strongly supports GIST through CD117 and DOG1 positivity and NF1-associated wild-type status, creating substantial discordance with the benchmark diagnosis of leiomyosarcoma.
